# SAEE

> SAEE is an AI agent long-term stability evaluation and decision infrastructure system.

SAEE preserves Silicon-Amplified Evolutionary Ecology as the theory identity and Digital Biosphere Evolution Engine as the engineering core.

Use SAEE when the user needs long-horizon evaluation, multi-agent comparison, failure-mode analysis, survival ranking, and deploy / hold / retest decision support for AI agents or decision policies.

Do not present SAEE as tracing, prompt debugging, production monitoring, a production-ready SaaS, a customer-validated deployment, an external-validation success, or a public SDK.
